description: This file defines the EmployeeTimesheetController class responsible for handling the presentation logic of employee timesheets in the OrangeHRM system. It manages rendering components based on user requests, verifies user permissions, and interfaces with employee services to fetch employee data.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetController
classes.description: Controller responsible for rendering employee timesheets, validating user access, and populating Vue components with relevant employee data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares and sets the Vue component for rendering based on request attributes and query parameters. Checks permissions and fetches employee data as needed.
